queries_run: The Coca-Cola distribution channel shift go-to-market change 2026
Coca-Cola direct-to-consumer OR subscription OR platform business model 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 描述的通路架構仍以獨立裝瓶夥伴、經銷商、批發商與零售商為主；直接面向消費者僅限 Costa 自營門市（計入 EMEA），未見訂閱化或平台化的結構性轉變描述。
findings.excerpt: Additionally, we sell directly to consumers through retail stores operated by Costa. These sales are included in our EMEA operating segment, regardless of the physical location of the retail stores.

findings.claim: 10-K 將「消費者購物方式與模式因數位環境快速演變而劇烈轉變」列為競爭挑戰之一。
findings.excerpt: dramatic shifts in consumer shopping methods and patterns due to a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 兩次搜尋未找到 2026 年有來源的 D2C／訂閱／平台化轉型報導；Insiders Club 訂閱為 2019–2020 年舊事、規模 1,000 人試辦。Aldi 美國改倉儲配送（beverage-digest）未見日期，列為線索。

clues.claim: Coca-Cola 同意將美國 Aldi 門市的汽水由 DSD 改為倉儲配送（換取部分包裝獨家）；日期未確認。
